ruleDefinitions.name: ETW Trace Evasion Activity
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects command line activity that tries to clear or disable any ETW trace log which could be a sign of logging evasion.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*cl.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Trace.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*clear\\-log.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Trace.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*sl.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/e\\:false.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*set\\-log.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/e\\:false.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*logman.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*update.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*trace.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-p.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-ets.*")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Remove\\-EtwTraceProvider.*") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*Set\\-EtwTraceProvider.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*0x11.*")))
